audit.source: Where you will be working:
audit.reason: Employer/location/application context heading

audit.source: Location: Emerald Place Clinic, Farmfield Drive, Charlwood, Horley, RH6 0BN
audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

audit.source: Emerald Place Clinic is a general adolescent inpatient unit for the care and treatment of young people aged 13 up to the age of 18.
audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

audit.source: Young people who are admitted to the unit will have a primary diagnosis of mental illness across a wide range of disorders and complex needs.
audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

audit.source: These could include mental health conditions such as mood disorders and acute psychosis.
audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

audit.source: Additionally young people may have co-existing additional needs such as neurodevelopmental disorders, including mild learning disabilities or autism.
audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

audit.source: A young person could also be admitted if they have disordered eating.
audit.reason: Employer/location/application context

audit.source: What You’ll Get
audit.reason: Employer benefits heading

audit.source: At Elysium Healthcare, we believe in taking care of the people who care for others, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and future:
audit.reason: Employer benefit; not a candidate requirement

audit.source: Annual base salary of £28,000
audit.reason: Employer benefit; not a candidate requirement

audit.source: The equivalent of 33 days annual leave (including bank holidays) – plus your birthday off and the option to buy additional annual leave, in our annual selection window.
audit.reason: Employer benefit; not a candidate requirement

audit.source: Career development and training to help you achieve your professional goals
audit.reason: Employer benefit; not a candidate requirement

audit.source: Access to our Rewards & Benefits platform Ely-Vate;
audit.reason: Employer benefit; not a candidate requirement

audit.source: Your one-stop destination for everyday savings, exclusive benefits, and wellbeing hub!
audit.reason: Employer benefit; not a candidate requirement

audit.source: Wellbeing support and activities to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance
audit.reason: Employer benefit; not a candidate requirement

audit.source: Access to Blue Light Card, which provides a range of exclusive offers and discounts
audit.reason: Employer benefit; not a candidate requirement

audit.source: Life Assurance, for added peace of mind
audit.reason: Employer benefit; not a candidate requirement

audit.source: Stream – instant access to earned wages when you need it, plus access to save, directly from your wages, alongside financial wellbeing support.
audit.reason: Employer benefit; not a candidate requirement

audit.source: 24/7 GP service and second medical opinion, to ensure you are the best you can be
audit.reason: Employer benefit; not a candidate requirement

audit.source: Enhanced Maternity Package, so you can truly enjoy this special time
audit.reason: Employer benefit; not a candidate requirement

audit.source: Pension contribution, to help secure your future
audit.reason: Employer benefit; not a candidate requirement

audit.source: Free meals and free parking
audit.reason: Employer benefit; not a candidate requirement

With previous experience in a similar role, and good organisational, communication and time management skills, you can enjoy a long and rewarding career, where a range of training opportunities are available that can see your career grow and career aspirations achieved.
